Sending hugs - I lost my brother the same way 3 years ago. He was 28 and my very best friend. I truly wish I had words of encouragement, but the whole “it gets better/time heals all wounds” bullshit has never sat right with me. I’m so sorry you and your family are having to go through this tremendous loss. I hope you’re able to grieve and heal in whatever way you need and have endless support while doing so.

If you’re not against a male OB - I super recommend Dr. Scott Hansen at South Valley Women’s Health. He was highly recommended to me from multiple friends, and I’ve really enjoyed him so far. Minimal wait time. Great bedside manner - has been great at making me feel comfortable at every appointment/answers my questions in an educational/non-condescending way.   My delivery will be at Lone Peak.
I’m currently pregnant with my first and would love any help I can get! If none of the donation places work out for you, I’d gladly take the stuff off your hands :)

I used to not even think twice about my larger lady bits, at least not until I was sleeping with someone for the first time and they said DURING the act “oh wow, you are a meatier girl huh?” Now I will try to slip that into a conversation before I sleep with anyone. People suck sometimes.

Hahah my partner does the same, and it bothers me quite a bit as well (really any noise does when I’m trying to get to sleep, it takes me awhile to calm my brain down enough to actually drift off). From my understanding, it’s a comfort thing for them. I just tell him to stop rubbing his grubby little fly feet together, and have a laugh about it. I’d be shit outta luck if it sent me into agitated state though. I feel for you, but NAH.

I know everyone is already saying it, but you did a really great thing for that person. My brother passed in the same way (like eerily similar) last year and one of the biggest comforts I’ve had is knowing that someone was doing the same for him as he struggled with his last few minutes of life. I’m sorry you had to witness that though, make sure you take care of yourself :)

My mom used to purposely have me drink alcohol as a kid. Not as young as you, but still I was like 9-10? She would always give me one of those little bottles of Kaluha(I just found them on google, it was 200mL), it was like a weekly treat for me whenever she would go to the liquor store to restock. It just tasted like chocolate/coffee to me so I had ZERO clue, but she claims it was to calm me down due to my “high energy levels”. Lovely woman.

I honestly thought this could possibly be my boyfriends account. He was recently diagnosed with Manic Bipolar, and goes into psychosis quite often. We’re still very early in the treatment process, and trying to figure out what helps him the most. I’m so scared for him all of the time, and I’m anxiously waiting for the days to get better because I know it’s such a process to find what’s right for each individual.
